name: Brendan
source:
Brendan is one of Red's potential roommates. He is a highly active and expressive individual rarely in a poor mood. He started dating May prior to the beginning of the story, as the two of them originated from Littleroot Town in the Hoenn region. Their relationship with each other is frequently explored, with Red playing major roles if Brendan is selected as the roommate.

Brendan was first introduced in Pokémon Ruby and Pokémon Sapphire versions.
